title: Happy Freedom
content:
At age 13 years old I had surgery with ether. Saw myself flat on my back speeding through a tunnel. All kinds of colored lights were on the walls inside — beautiful colors and a bright light at the end, brighter than the sun. But it didn’t hurt to look at it. As I got closer and closer and almost to the light, I woke up — about a week later. I just seemed to have passed out in the tunnel.

At 61 years old — 2002 had lithium overdose due to V.A. hospital not properly monitoring lithium level. I had two experiences this time. I am not sure if they are joined or separate events. If they are separate, I don’t know how much time lapsed between them.

1. I saw myself as a two year old baby boy floating around in a beautiful blue sky - so happy and care free. As the sun shined through the blue sky, it created a rainbow of beautiful rainbow colors. I was so happy and so free. I saw a flock of beautiful eagles flying overhead. Laughing and playing, I flapped my arms in a flying motion so I could fly up and touch one. I never touched one.

2. It was a darkness as dark as the center of a piece of coal. And I was the same two year old little boy. I was so free and so happy as I played in that darkness. Like before, it was fantastic to be so happy and care free. I saw a bright star high up in the sky. I started pushing myself up with my feet. The darkness was so thick. I held out my right arm with my index finger extended so I could touch that beautiful star, and like before, everything just seemed to disappear before I could touch anything.

environment.environment_other_detail: Beautiful blue sky; sun creating a rainbow of colors; also a darkness “as dark as the center of a piece of coal” with a bright star high up.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Age 13 surgery with ether; later (age 61, 2002) lithium overdose due to V.A. hospital not properly monitoring lithium level.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two later experiences as a “two year old baby boy” in a blue sky with rainbow colors and eagles; and in extremely dark darkness with a bright star.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Age 13: OBE and tunnel with bright light at end; later events: childlike self in sky/darkness reaching toward eagle/star, with the scene disappearing before contact.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two later experiences with similar pattern: joyful play, reaching toward something (eagle/star), then it disappears before touch.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experiencer perceived self as a two-year-old boy during later episodes; joyful play in complete darkness; scene “disappeared” before touching eagle/star.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “darkness as dark as the center of a piece of coal.”
